verdict.rationale: First-party RTX 50 Series marketing names PyTorch, alongside Windows ML and Ollama, as a supported inference backend, and notes optimized ComfyUI workflows. The CUDA Toolkit page documents a compiler, runtime, GPU-accelerated libraries, Python tile kernels and Nsight profiling, so the core software stack exists. None of this is an officially documented PyTorch build or framework support matrix for this GPU. missing for 10: official PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX build or install docs for the 5070 Ti, a framework/CUDA version support matrix covering Blackwell consumer GPUs, training (not just inference) framework support, independent or hands-on corroboration that mainstream frameworks run on this card.
